sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about skills using tud, and grade them with jól/rosszul.
I can say I'm not able to do something and explain why, and tell nem tud apart from nem lehet.
I can ask and answer whether something is possible using lehet + infinitive.
I can ask and answer whether something is allowed using szabad, and use nem szabad as a strong prohibition.
I can combine tud, lehet, and szabad in one conversation, and recognize common -hat/-het forms like mehetek.
